Alisa: quick flag  Ventus adapter merge (ventus/lora-v2) on int8 shows numeric-token breakup and currency glyphs missing in QA quick-eval.

Mohit: which evalpack and samples?

Alisa: evalpack=ventus-qc-2026-04. CI quick summary: QA 91.9% -> 87.6%, token anomalies=10, failures concentrated on numeric formats e.g. '12,345' -> '12 , 345', '€99' -> '99'.

Dana: likely token-id shift from grafted vocab. Any special tokens inserted by the LoRA?

Alisa: yes, adapter created a special token <AMT> inserted into token_map near the numeric range. I hadn't run a remap post-merge.

Sam: try re-run with a remap JSON and the --no-kv-cache flag to eliminate caching side-effects.

Alisa: ran: ./tools/quick_eval --model ventus-lora-v2 --quant=int8 --evalpack ventus-qc-2026-04 --tok-remap=remap-ventus.json --no-kv-cache
Partial logs: sample 22: 'Order total: 12,345' -> parsed as '12 , 345' before remap; after remap contiguous numeric tokens restored.

eval-bot: remap run: QA 91.9% -> 91.5% (-0.4), anomalies reduced to 1, perf +2.5% latency on int8.

Mohit: good. Action items: (1) add auto-remap generation step to the LoRA merge flow, (2) post-merge token-id histogram check focusing on numeric and currency glyphs, (3) opt-in CI smoke test to run tok-remap. Also upload token histograms to S3 for CS.

Dana: add a short note in the adapter onboarding docs about token-index shifts and remap tooling.

Sam: opening PR merge/ventus-remap-176601 to wire up remap generation and histogram upload, pinging @Mohit for review.

ci-bot: ticket TKT-48732 updated with artifacts: /artifacts/ventus/remap-ventus.json, /artifacts/ventus/smoke-176601.json

Alisa: I'll draft the CS handoff with the remap and smoke output attached.
